desc: Create an app from an app manifest.

manifest.desc: A JSON app manifest encoded as a string. This manifest **must** use a valid [app manifest schema - read our guide to creating one](/app-manifests/configuring-apps-with-app-manifests#fields).

team_id.desc: When called with an org token, which specific team to create app on
The team ID where the app was created on

team_domain.desc: The team domain where the app was created on

invalid_app.desc: An app created from the provided manifest would not be valid.

invalid_manager_app.desc: The calling app is not enrolled as a manager app. Ensure the app has `app_configurations:write` in its configured scopes and its home team has manager app support enabled.

invalid_manifest.desc: The provided manifest file does not validate against schema. Consult the additional errors field to locate specific issues.

invalid_team_id.desc: The provided team ID is not valid

not_in_team.desc: Cannot create an app in a team that user is not a member of

failed_adding_collaborator.desc: Failed writing a collaborator record for this new app

failed_creating_app.desc: Failed to create the app model

failed_generating_app_token.desc: App level token failed to generate.

feature_not_enabled.desc: The required feature is not enabled for this workspace.

managed_app_limit_reached.desc: The manager app has reached the maximum number of managed apps it can create.

ratelimited.desc: Too many calls in succession to create endpoint during a short period of time.

socket_mode_not_enabled.desc: Socket mode is not enabled in manifest.

dynamic_client_registration_invalid_redi.desc: The remote server rejected Slack's redirect URI during Dynamic Client Registration. The server must allowlist https://oauth2.slack.com/external/auth/callback as a valid redirect URI.

dynamic_client_registration_failed.desc: Dynamic client registration failed for an MCP server that requires OAuth authentication.

oauth_metadata_not_found.desc: Could not discover OAuth metadata for the MCP server. Ensure the server exposes a .well-known/oauth-authorization-server or .well-known/openid-configuration endpoint.

dynamic_client_registration_not_supporte.desc: The MCP server's OAuth metadata does not include a registration endpoint. The server may not support Dynamic Client Registration.

dynamic_client_registration_missing_oaut.desc: The MCP server's OAuth metadata is missing a required authorization or token endpoint.

dynamic_client_registration_rejected.desc: The MCP server rejected the Dynamic Client Registration request.

dynamic_client_registration_invalid_resp.desc: The MCP server returned an invalid response during Dynamic Client Registration.
